title: Embedding provider boundary
objective: Introduce the Rust EmbeddingProvider trait, request/response types, mock provider, registry factory, and manager routing before implementing concrete embedding HTTP providers.

steps.description: Study AstrBot EmbeddingProvider, OpenAI embedding source, Gemini embedding source, and manager embedding provider bucket.
Add EmbeddingRequest, EmbeddingResponse, EmbeddingProvider, and MockEmbeddingProvider to astrbot-provider.
Add EmbeddingProviderConfig, mock embedding registration, registry build methods, and ProviderManager embedding routing.
Add tests for embedding metadata, default selection, requested-provider routing, batch responses, dimensions, and termination.
Run formatting, workspace tests, clippy, and CLI smoke verification.
